our_interpretation: Assess selling difficulty, as specified by the normalized claim, rather than the separate judgment about fair valuation.
Material difficulty means weak subscriptions, meaningful pricing concessions from the marketed range, or postponement or withdrawal attributable to insufficient demand.
The condition requires an observable substantial AI-stock selloff during the offering process; it does not require a particular technical definition of crash.
Strong preliminary orders are relevant counterevidence but do not establish final pricing or completed allocation.
